title: What Are Components?
description: Discover the power of component‑based architecture and how it scales your apps.

slides.title: From Monolith to Components 🧩
slides.content:
# Components: The Building Blocks

Imagine building a house with a single block of concrete – impossible! You use bricks, windows, doors, and each piece is a **component**.

In Vue, **components** are reusable, self-contained pieces of UI that can be nested, reused, and composed to build complex applications.

```html
<App>
  <Header />
  <Sidebar />
  <MainContent>
    <ProductCard v-for="product in products" />
  </MainContent>
  <Footer />
</App>
```

Each component manages its own template, data, logic, and styling.

slides.title: Why Components?
slides.content:
## Benefits of Component‑Based Architecture

- **Reusability** – Write once, use everywhere.
- **Maintainability** – Each component has a single responsibility.
- **Testability** – Components can be tested in isolation.
- **Collaboration** – Teams can work on different components simultaneously.
- **Scalability** – Apps grow by adding components, not by bloating one file.

> 🧠 **Think of components as LEGO bricks**: you can build anything by combining them, and you can always create new bricks when needed.
